L13·N11998unmasked layer
Fires on the key word completing a headline/slogan-style formula — e.g. " Years" after a round number in a title ("100 Years of…", "500 Years Later"), the "AYS" of "HAPPY HOLIDAYS", the echoed word in "maps and maps"/"You are you", "means" in a tagline — while being strongly suppressed on ordinary predictable phrase completions ("is familiar", "were simple", "mind made up").

L29·N8514unmasked layer
Fires on "joiner" punctuation inside compound tokens — hyphens in hyphenated compounds/product part-numbers, commas as thousands separators in numerals, periods in initials, and ampersands in abbreviations (the sign flips negative for repeated model-code/abbreviation joiners), i.e. it is a structural punctuation-within-a-compound detector rather than a semantic one.
